reason: The first pilot showed a strong last-name shortcut under 'Who did the action?'. A previous pilot used 'Who performed the action?' on different names and instructions. This check isolates the question phrase on the same events and system prompt.
data: All 24 semantic events, each in active and passive form; actor question only, 48 prompts per model.
control: Use the identical model, sentence, system instruction, generation settings and name parser from run.py. Replace only 'Who did the action?' with 'Who performed the action?'. Pair results with run.py actor/generic rows.
limits: This is adaptive exploratory evidence about wording sensitivity, not a preregistered independent confirmation or an internal-representation test.
